The '''Droid Spa''' was a [[Spa/Legends|spa]] for [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that operated during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Todo 360/Legends|Todo 360]] and [[HELIOS-3E/Legends|HELIOS-3E]] tricked [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] into entering the spa, so they could capture [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], which would allow them to acquire the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building's]] plans for the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]]. The [[Spa droid/Legends|spa droids]] [[SN-D1/Legends|SN-D1]] and [[BO-N1/Legends|BO-N1]] worked there.
